boxes.question: Does the report use the title “A Study on the Effects of Different Salinity Stress Levels on Rice Seedling Growth”?
Does the report center the experiment on rice seedlings?
Does the report investigate how salinity affects rice seedling growth metrics?
Does the report describe an experimental design that includes a control group irrigated with pure water?
Does the report include at least three experimental groups assigned different salt concentration levels?
Is the report clear and coherent enough to explain its experimental design and purpose?
